We hold the licences required in the United States and Canada. X has approved our account for financial services ads in the United States and Canada. Available only on iPhone (iOS) and Android phones: choose your app store below to install."

Done — flight ran July 24-28 Central and is now paused.

What I launched:
- Campaign `Tervilo School Installs Jul 24-28` in account Tervilo (`America/Chicago`), objective `WEBSITE_CLICKS` / goal `LINK_CLICKS`. No app-install campaign or app ID was set because there is no X pixel — link clicks to https://tervilo.app/school are the proxy for installs.
- 2 ad groups, US + Canada location, iOS + Android only, `ALL_ON_TWITTER`:
  - Cutoff post 2212427518575471207
  - General post 2212246324639150169
- Post 2212065130708528326 was not found in the account, so I could only promote the 2 that exist. I did not create any new copy.
- Managed mid-flight: after Day 1 the cutoff post had 23 clicks vs 16 with far fewer impressions, so I shifted budget to it. On July 27 I paused the general ad group and moved remaining cap to the winner. Total caps stayed at $650.00.

Recap July 24 00:00 to July 28 24:00 Central:
- Spend: $647.19
- Impressions: 526,717
- Link clicks: 240

By ad group:
- Cutoff: $507.20, 350,016 impressions, 196 link clicks
- General: $139.99, 176,701 impressions, 44 link clicks
